## Evidence report
Implemented the three OKC document connectors (`okc_procurement`, `okcpd_policy`, `ok_statute`) as one shared `OkcDocumentConnector` base + three registered subclasses over the ADR-033-deferred sig-parsing layers (`parsing.tables` `pdf_table`, `parsing.clauses` `pdf_text`, `parsing.genre` re-derived from text). Every claim is built through `okc_claim`, which enforces the per-connector predicate allowlist (SIG-INGEST-033) and the Part VIII guard (no plate/trip/per-person/per-search data; officer-naming gate; sensitivity tier stamped) — each guard covered by a fail-if-removed test. `shadow_replay` diff = 0 proves fetch→capture→parse→emit is deterministic and byte-identical over the committed fixtures (SIG-INGEST-019), the compensating control for the HG-09-deferred live smoke (`D-LIVE.1a-1`). HG-03 is satisfied (RIGHTS.1). Closes BL-023/024/026 (connector-code half); the live fetch / transport re-run stays with P21.3.
